Maps from my research, each with a short note on what it shows.

## Florida's Population and Growth, 2020–2050

Where Floridians live now, and where the state is expected to grow. Drag the slider across the map to compare each county's 2020 population (blue) with its projected growth from 2020 to 2050 (red). Click a county for details.

## Florida's Impaired Waters

Florida checks the health of its rivers, lakes, springs, estuaries, and coastal waters by dividing them into assessment units called waterbody IDs (WBIDs). Waters that fail state standards for things like nutrients, bacteria, or dissolved oxygen go on the **verified impaired list**, which means the state has to set a pollution limit for them. Click any waterbody to see its name and what it's listed for.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://js.arcgis.com/4.30/esri/themes/light/main.css">
<div class="viewer map live-map">
  <div id="impaired-map" role="region" aria-label="Map of Florida waterbodies showing which are on the state's verified impaired list"></div>
  <div class="map-status" id="impaired-status">Loading Florida DEP data…</div>
</div>
<script>
setTimeout(function () {
  var st = document.getElementById("impaired-status");
  if (st && !st.hidden) st.innerHTML = "The map couldn't load here. <a href='https://geodata.dep.state.fl.us/datasets/FDEP::waterbody-ids-wbids/about'>View the data on Florida DEP's site</a>.";
}, 45000);
</script>
<script src="https://js.arcgis.com/4.30/"></script>
<script>
require([
  "esri/Map", "esri/views/MapView", "esri/layers/FeatureLayer", "esri/layers/TileLayer", "esri/Basemap",
  "esri/widgets/Legend", "esri/widgets/Expand", "esri/widgets/Home"
], function (Map, MapView, FeatureLayer, TileLayer, Basemap, Legend, Expand, Home) {
  var status = document.getElementById("impaired-status");
  var DEP = "https://ca.dep.state.fl.us/arcgis/rest/services/OpenData/";
  var FALLBACK_VERIFIED = "https://taurus.at.geoplan.ufl.edu/arcgis/rest/services/fgdl/FDEP_Water/MapServer/8";

  var basemap = new Basemap({ baseLayers: [new TileLayer({
    url: "https://services.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer"
  })] });

  function popup(title) {
    return { title: title, outFields: ["*"], content: function (f) {
      var a = f.graphic.attributes, rows = "";
      Object.keys(a).forEach(function (k) {
        if (/^(objectid|fid|shape|globalid|autoid)/i.test(k) || a[k] === null || a[k] === "") return;
        if (!/(wbid|name|param|class|type|cause|basin|group|cycle|county|status|category)/i.test(k)) return;
        rows += "<tr><th>" + k.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase() + "</th><td>" + a[k] + "</td></tr>";
      });
      return rows ? "<table class='esri-widget__table'>" + rows + "</table>" : "No details available.";
    }};
  }
  function fill(c, o) { return { type: "simple-fill", color: c, outline: { color: o, width: 0.5 } }; }

  var view = new MapView({ container: "impaired-map", map: new Map({ basemap: basemap }),
    center: [-83.6, 27.9], zoom: 6, constraints: { minZoom: 5 }, popup: { dockEnabled: false } });
  view.ui.add(new Home({ view: view }), "top-left");
  view.ui.add(new Expand({ view: view, expanded: window.innerWidth > 700,
    content: new Legend({ view: view }), expandTooltip: "Legend" }), "bottom-left");

  // All assessed waterbodies: Florida DEP Waterbody IDs
  var all = new FeatureLayer({ url: DEP + "WBIDS/MapServer/0", title: "Waterbodies (WBIDs)", outFields: ["*"],
    renderer: { type: "simple", label: "Not on the verified impaired list", symbol: fill([31,127,153,0.28], [31,127,153,0.7]) },
    popupTemplate: popup("Waterbody") });
  view.map.add(all);

  // Find the verified impaired layer in DEP's impaired waters service
  function json(u) { return fetch(u + (u.indexOf("?") > -1 ? "&" : "?") + "f=json").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }); }
  function findVerified() {
    return json(DEP + "IMPAIRED_WATERS/MapServer").then(function (svc) {
      var hit = (svc.layers || []).filter(function (l) { return /verified/i.test(l.name) && !/delist/i.test(l.name); })[0];
      if (!hit) throw new Error("no verified layer");
      return DEP + "IMPAIRED_WATERS/MapServer/" + hit.id;
    }).catch(function () { return FALLBACK_VERIFIED; });
  }

  var ok = 0, bad = [];
  function report() {
    if (ok + bad.length < 2) return;
    if (!ok) status.innerHTML = "The state's map data didn't load. <a href='https://geodata.dep.state.fl.us/datasets/FDEP::waterbody-ids-wbids/about'>View it on Florida DEP's site</a>.";
    else status.hidden = true;
    if (bad.length) console.warn("[impaired-map] failed:", bad);
  }
  all.load().then(function () { ok++; report(); }, function (e) { bad.push(["WBIDs", e && e.message]); report(); });

  findVerified().then(function (url) {
    var impaired = new FeatureLayer({ url: url, title: "Verified impaired", outFields: ["*"],
      renderer: { type: "simple", label: "Verified impaired (needs a pollution limit, or TMDL)", symbol: fill([200,102,31,0.6], [150,60,10,0.9]) },
      popupTemplate: popup("Impaired waterbody") });
    view.map.add(impaired);
    impaired.load().then(function () { ok++; report(); console.info("[impaired-map] verified layer:", url); },
                         function (e) { bad.push(["verified", e && e.message]); report(); });
  });
});
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="map-key"><span class="k-imp">Verified impaired</span><span class="k-ok">Not on the verified impaired list</span></div>
<p class="map-credit">Data: Florida Department of Environmental Protection, Waterbody IDs and Verified List of Impaired Waters, loaded live from DEP's map server. Waters not on the verified list aren't necessarily healthy. Some have too little data to assess, and others are impaired but already have a pollution limit in place.</p>
```
